deprecations.contract: SegmentedControl deprecated semantic role aliases: tablist and radiogroup; retained compatibility API
deprecations.replacement: Prefer mode="tabs" or mode="radio". Explicit mode takes precedence; when omitted, a valid deprecated role alias selects matching child semantics. Future removal requires the unchanged major, two published minors and 90-day notice policy.

pendingChanges.description: The default package entry changes from raw JSX to compiled ESM; explicit source entry remains available.
Menu adopts the approved APG arrow-key and Tab-closes interaction contract.
Floating panels use body placement by default, with explicit inline opt-out and automatic native form/fieldset fallback.
SegmentedControl defaults to radiogroup semantics for value selection; caller-rendered panels use explicit tabs mode.
SegmentedControl retains deprecated tablist/radiogroup semantic role aliases; unsupported arbitrary role values reject instead of silently overriding or being ignored by owned group semantics.
